items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: And the Ben Pollack band was a great favorite of mine

ctx.x: So it was a good experience for me, and as a matter of fact, we all by that point -- I did especially, had my own desires as to where -- what kind of music to play. And I was certainly interested in the jazz of that time. And the Ben Pollack band was a great favorite of mine, along with Benny's band and everyone else who was into playing swinging music.
